title: Named in an audit, review or grand-jury report, and not yet written up here
question: Which large City payees has an auditor, grand jury, City Attorney or prosecutor already written about that this site has no case on?
finding: 11 organizations paid $1 million or more since FY2019 (together $267 million) are named in the title of, or at least three times in, an audit, integrity review, grand-jury report, City Attorney action or prosecutor's record, and have no case file on this site.
how: The same index, kept where the organization is a profiled nonprofit or a top-300 business payee, has been paid $1 million or more, is named in a serious document either in its title or three or more times (not counting documents that are lists of 25 or more organizations), and is not an actor in, charted in, or named in the text of any case file.
limits: This is a reading list, not a list of suspects. Many of these documents are routine: a budget audit that discusses the largest contractors, or a grand-jury report that praises a program. The point is that someone official has already looked, so the document is the fastest way to learn whether there is anything to follow.
